Proposal.title: Proposal
Proposal.description: A corporate training proposal generated and managed by a consultant in Impak Niaga.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the proposal owner.

status.description: Current workflow status of the proposal.

totalBudget.description: Total calculated proposal budget in RM.

formData.description: Structured program configuration, custom cost items, and document inclusion flags.

aiContent.description: Generated and edited proposal sections, modules, and optional custom tentative rows.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when proposal was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when proposal was last updated.

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Company letterhead branding, digital signature/stamp, and default trainer profile for a user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

branding.description: Letterhead contact details, reference prefix, client logo, signature, and stamp data URLs.

trainerProfile.description: Default trainer CV details and photo data URL.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update.

/proposals/{proposalId}.description: Stores saved corporate training proposals owned by authenticated users.

/userSettings/{userId}.description: Stores private company branding, digital signature, stamp, and trainer CV settings per user.
